name: ce.memory_map
description: List target memory regions with module and protection metadata. Pagination bounds output only: enumeration and naming of all regions happen before paging. BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE was reproduced even with moduleFilter and limit=5. Avoid repeated failing calls or parallel diagnostic batches; inspect ce.status and isolate enumeration/transport timing before retrying.

limit.description: Bounds output page size only, not enumeration work or latency; a small limit does not prevent the reproduced BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE failure.
